svg.title: Moeka: the relationship layer for your AI workers.
svg.desc: A network of memory nodes with amber hubs, each a delegated worker session. Moeka remembers what you want, briefs a stronger agent, follows up and brings the result back.

g.text: Briefs the stronger agent. Follows up. Brings the result back.
